Kara (Content): Shared the latest launch blog draft. Need quick copy pass + confirm HubSpot mapping: https://notion.so/redwood/launch-v2-draft

Ethan (Growth): Can we split the CTAs? Primary CTA = Start free trial; Secondary CTA = Request demo for enterprise. Need arr_band hidden field on demo.

Nina (Design): hero image looks great but fig2 missing alt. Also we should add a slim benchmark summary card.

Sam (Ops): Sales routing: demo form -> Sales Ops queue C. Trial form -> CRM auto-provision trial. I will share the form IDs in the doc.

Legal Bot: replace direct competitor comparisons with "vs. comparable open-source runtimes" unless sourced. Also flag pricing claims.

Kara (Content): will remove specific competitor names and soften pricing claims. Adding a footnote: "cost figures are illustrative; see customer appendix for details."

tracking-bot: GA event snippet suggested and alt text reminder.

Ethan (Growth): I'll add a 2-line webinar teaser under CTAs: "June 11, 10:00 PT  deep-dive + live Q&A".

Kara (Content): thanks. will update and ping when done.
